description:
Ideal ride for off-road cycling and going to school or work. This electric mountain bike is perfect for adventure lovers, trail bikers, working moms and dads, students, office workers, and city dwellers.

The electric bikes adopt superior 100% percent aluminum alloy frame, front suspension fork has outstanding shock absorption characteristics, allowing you to run unimpeded in any terrain without fear of bumps. It can educe the bumps, make climbing easier, and save more effort when riding long distances

Matrix LCD display gives you all information you need: Odo, trip, speed, motor output, battery indicator, and of course advanced settings.

Front/Rear mechanical disc brake

Easy riding: throttle; pedal assistant pedaling ；

Equipped with big comfortable saddle with strong damping spring, you will never feel tired even after a long distances riding, which is essential for new fat tire electric bike riders

Durable: high-strength carbon steel frame and superior car paint, the bike will serve you for several years. The Motor is made of a high-quality alloy material.

26'' Wheels, with 4'' Fat tire. none slip on wet grounds and neither do they sink in mud or snow.

It's equipped with a high speed 500 Watts motor, perfect for city strollers.

48V 12Ah Li-ion removeable battery. Easy to take out. Charging time 4-6 hours.

Shimano 6-speed-gears
